description: The Global Bioenergy Power Tracker from Global Energy Monitor (GEM), a non-profit research organisation, is a worldwide data set of bioenergy combustion power facilities, including co-firing with fossil fuels. On 26 September 2026 the page counted 4,816 units in 122 countries and areas, 120 GW operating and 16.6 GW prospective capacity. Records give capacity, operational status, technology, fuel type (woody biomass, refuse, agricultural waste), location and ownership. The latest release was September 2026. Coverage is global. Access is through a free online tracker map, dashboards and summary tables, and the full data set is a spreadsheet downloadable through a short download form on GEM's site, under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Caveats: the tracker takes a critical view of bioenergy in its commentary, but the data themselves are facility records. Simulation uses are generation fleet inputs, fuel supply chain and co-firing studies and exposure of plants near populated areas. Related records: data-gem-global-integrated-power-tracker combines GEM's power trackers and data-gem-global-energy-ownership-tracker maps owners.
